simple.meaning: מְקֻצְעָה (mᵉqutsʻâh) is a Hebrew action word meaning “an angle.” BibleIQ anchors the English reading to this source verb before comparing its uses.
simple.biblicalBackground: This action appears 2 times in Exodus, beginning at Exodus 26:23. Its meaning becomes clearer as the uses are compared.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to מְקֻצְעָה (H4742) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Actions in Scripture show what people do, what God does, and how covenant faithfulness or rebellion is described. BibleIQ compares the action across its occurrences.
simple.summary: מְקֻצְעָה (mᵉqutsʻâh) / H4742 is traced through Exodus 26:23, Exodus 36:28 with source-language evidence and verse context.
